newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE DELAYED, MORE STOCKS SUSPENDED.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE DELAYED, MORE STOCKS SUSPENDED.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse's order- balancing session after price fixing has begun fifteen minutes later on Monday and will end fifteen minutes later at 1015 GMT, a bourse representative said.
A source told Reuters that trade in four more main market firms -- Gorazdze , Olawa , Polifarb Wroclaw and Remak -- and one parallel market firm, Viscoplast, has been suspended.
Trade in Rafako and ZEW has already been suspended due to flooding in southern Poland.
